source_text: Psychological effects in Gambian girls post-FGC include probable post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) at 19.2% prevalence among 12-year-olds, though only 4.2% attribute it directly to FGC, with 95.8% linked to confounding serious life events like violence or bereavement (average 4.5 events per girl).
